decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (DIA01_d5_bp; DIA01_d5_da; DIA_05_el; DIA_d5_pl; DIA01_d5_roof; DIA01_d5_sl; DIA_d5_tree location. Received: 31/12/2017.
DIA_d5_flood. Received: 08/01/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than for storage ancillary to the application property and shall not be used as primary accommodation such as a living room, bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, study or as a self-contained dwelling.
description: Erection of a timber framed garden room to rear garden of the house
